communication.subject: Happy Birthday, Sarah!
communication.body: Dear Sarah, on your special day, I want to express how grateful I am for our friendship. Here's to another year of love, laughter, and adventure together! Wishing you a birthday as bright and beautiful as you are.
communication.short_message: Wishing you a happy birthday, Sarah!

alternatives: Push notification with a birthday GIF

input.situation: Create a warm and beautiful birthday wish for my best friend Sarah. Make it friendly, heartfelt, and not too long.

decision.title: Birthday Wishes for Moon
decision.reason: A push notification is suitable for a celebratory message to the team.

communication.subject: Happy Birthday to the Moon!
communication.body: Dear Team, today marks a special day - the Moon's birthday! Let's take a moment to appreciate the beauty and significance of our celestial neighbor. Wishing you all a wonderful day.

alternatives: Email with a custom birthday template
A team-wide announcement on the company's internal platform
